fact: The Office of the President's government directory lists, 'as from 1st March 2025', 27 district administration offices under the Ministry of Local Government and Community Affairs, each with its own office mailbox on the government's gov.sc domain (anseauxpinsda@gov.sc to takamakada@gov.sc) beside an office telephone number; it states nothing else of what the offices do online.

The government directory's table of district administrations, dated 1 March 2025, lists 27 districts, Praslin's two and La Digue among them, and gives every one of the 27 an office mailbox on gov.sc; the directory states no total of districts beyond its own list.
